datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments and compiled Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data across Somalia administrative units for 2021. The spatial classifications were aggregated into monthly geographic datasets representing food insecurity scenarios and phases, indicating the underlying drought hazard impact on food security.

sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic units in Somalia.
